notes: The fronted Are of the question belongs to the interrogative particle (rules 17, 50); the existential ayin keeps is not and heads on not.
In the first come upon clause no marker stands, so the supplied preposition joins the verb (rule 44); contrast DEU.31.21, where a marker takes it.
hayah le + infinitive recast as a passive keeps the copula on hayah and leaves the lamed unrepresented (rule 21).
